media.alt: A 24 second vertical video. Owner Justin Myrick stands in the empty, carpeted room in Orange Park where the Fore Motion Golf bays go and gestures around it. The shot softly dissolves into one continuous 3D concept view, labeled Concept, that eases down to the spectator counters and moves past all four simulator bays: counters and stools, couches, tee mats, golfers and course screens. A deep green band at the bottom reads Owner Justin Myrick walks the space, then The bays, the 3D venue concept, as planned, then Four bays, leagues and events, four bays. The logo sits at the top and foremotiongolf.com at the foot. It ends on a deep green card: Join the Founders List, early access to launch events and leagues, foremotiongolf.com.

Owner Justin Myrick in a mint green polo stands in a long, empty carpeted room past old service counters, gesturing, with the Fore Motion Golf logo at the top and a deep green band below that reads Owner Justin Myrick walks the space, and foremotiongolf.com.
